notes.title: Unlimited Escape 2 is now live on Steam at 15% off!
notes.notes: The adventure of our hero continues beyond the legend, with new scenarios and dangers! The protagonist of the game will walk and explore endless mazes procedurally generated and will have a single mission: to save the prisoners scattered in the path leading them to the point of rescue.
